title: Nutty Velvety French Pistachio Tart
description: A fresh and velvety French dessert featuring unsalted pistachio and render-fat, perfect for those looking for a low-glycemic-friendly treat. This tart is a delightful combination of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and salt.
Add the chopped pistachio to the bowl and stir until well combined.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, render-fat, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until a smooth dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Trim the edges and press the dough into the corners of the pan.
Bake the tart shell for 20 minutes, then set aside to cool.
In a small bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Spread the whipped cream over the cooled tart shell and top with additional chopped pistachio if desired.
